sam (Docs): Drafting the sprint release notes + migration steps. Includes whatsnew blurb, JS/Python streaming snippet updates, and two known issues (preview TTL and legacy anchor redirects). Quick eyes?
lia (Eng): Quick ask: make the whatsnew banner explicit that Dedicated customers are unaffected by routing fallback.
sam (Docs): Will do. Proposed whatsnew: "Adaptive routing may fall back to compatible model variants under peak load — lowers cost but can affect tail latency. Hosted API only; Dedicated unaffected." Thoughts?
tom (SDK): Good. Also update all code samples to use client.responses.stream() (JS) and client.responses.stream(...) in Python — old helpers deprecated. Minimal JS snippet:```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'Summarize the changes' });
for await (const p of stream) console.log(p.text);
``` Minimal Py snippet:```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='rwd-3b', input='Summarize'):
    print(chunk.text)
```
tom (SDK): Add a version note: JS >= 1.4.0, Py >= 0.9.0. Mention old names .streamResponses()/.stream_raw() are deprecated with warnings.
naya (Support): Please add a short troubleshooting checklist for customers who hit deprecation warnings: 1) Check SDK version; 2) npm/pip upgrade to latest; 3) clear local caches and restart. I'll paste into canned replies.
sam (Docs): Added migration checklist. Also adding reranker note: rwd-ranker-v1 alias will be removed soon; migrate to rwd-ranker-v2 and reindex (ENG-2505).
lia (Eng): Ops update: CDN fix is deployed. Public docs links default to 14-day TTL now; publisher preview links still expire after 1 hour. We're tracking ENG-2509 to unify. Workaround: publish to stable page or request a longer preview TTL.
sam (Docs): Adding known-issue: "Publisher preview links (1-hour TTL) may expire when shared externally; workaround: publish stable page or request extended TTL. (ENG-2509)"
deploy-bot: PR 5284 opened by sam: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5284|view PR> :spiral_note_pad:
naya (Support): One more request — can you bold the migration headline in the whatsnew so it stands out for support followups?
sam (Docs): Will bold the migration header in the whatsnew section (not the short banner). Aiming to merge after 30-min review. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
